text:
Maya R: Quick kickoff: NorthSea Vault (HSM vendor + SI) wants a joint marketplace listing + integration docs. Primary asks: SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning with group filters, and BYOK via PKCS#11. Need checklist and owners by EOW. @Omar Khan @Priya Singh

Omar Khan: Sounds good. My proposed checklist: 1) SAML metadata exchange + test accounts; 2) SCIM attribute mapping and delta sync tests; 3) KMS/BYO operational runbook (import, wrap, rotate); 4) marketplace tile copy + logos + legal signoff; 5) regression tests for Dedicated customers.

Priya Singh: Security note: we require either FIPS-validated HSM or partner SOC2 + HSM provider attestation. Also want a short threat-model doc for BYOK flows. SCIM must not allow full directory dumps; partner must support group-based sync or filter by 'urn:redwood:entitlement'.

Maya R: For SAML, partner requested SP-initiated login and metadata URL. Example we shared to partners earlier:
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://console.redwood.ai/saml/metadata\">
  <SPSSODescriptor>...
</EntityDescriptor>
```
We should add a quick troubleshooting section for cert rotation and clock skew.

Omar Khan: SCIM mapping example for entitlements:
```
scim->redwood
external:groups -> user.entitlements
external:employeeType -> user.role
filters: groupPrefix=\"nsv-\"
```
We'll include automated scim smoke tests in staging.

Priya Singh: BYOK runbook draft outline: (A) verify certs and PKCS#11 module on partner side, (B) export key-wrapping key from Redwood KMS (wrapped), (C) import into partner HSM using secure channel, (D) run sample encrypt/decrypt and rotate. Add rollback: failover to Redwood-managed keys and notify customers. Also need audit events captured: import, wrap, rotate, admin-grant.

Jules (partners-bot): Created draft playbook at https://docs.internal/partners/northsea-vault/onboard-playbook (edit: Maya,Omar,Priya). Preflight CI: scim-smoke queued, saml-meta-check queued.

Maya R: Timeline: draft by Thu EOD, internal review Fri, partner review following Mon, press embargo target three weeks out. Who owns the marketplace tile?

Omar Khan: I'll own the marketplace tile and the test matrix. Priya owns security docs and forensic logging requirements. Maya will run partner coordination and announcement timeline.

Priya Singh: One more thing: for Dedicated customers we need a short snippet for ops on how to switch a tenant between Redwood-managed KMS and partner BYOK with minimal downtime. I'll add commands and a preflight checklist.

Maya R: Perfect. I'll send a 30m sync tomorrow 11am PT to finalize owners and embargo contacts. :spiral_calendar: :white_check_mark:

Omar Khan: Adding a tiny acceptance test: create user via SCIM with group ns-ops, ensure entitlement shows up in app and can access a sample protected route. If fails, block GA.

Priya Singh: Agreed. Also require we capture sample log lines for audit pipeline so partner can ingest them.

Maya R: Thanks all, will post the playbook link and invite.
